title: feat(spec)!: retire FormView modalSize — no form view opens in a dialog

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoEsDWNHBngR2f45xU322DeW)_

Fixes #36544
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyCTygnt62jKN3Wmxu

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no hand-written skills page teaches a form view's `modalSize`; the one skills file that listed it is the generated `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`, regenerated here, and two evals in `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` already carry `modalSize:` under `must_not_contain`

## 维护者速读
- 搭建者在表单视图上写「弹窗大小」这一项，现在保存时会被拒绝并被告知删掉它；以前能存进去，却不改变任何界面。已经存下的旧表单照常打开，界面没有变化。
- 属于「声明了却没人执行的配置，要么执行要么移除」这条清理线，替以为这一项能调新建和编辑弹窗大小的搭建者和 AI 解决白写的问题。
- 还在写这一项的应用升到下一个大版本时会在保存处报错，迁移工具能自动删掉；若判断有误可以直接撤回，已存数据不受影响。
- 这是对外的破坏性收窄，并且改到了对外发布的技能包里一份生成的参考表，需要你最终批准。

## What changes
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: `FormViewSchema.modalSize` becomes a `retiredKey()` tombstone. The refusal names the removal version, says why (no form view opens in a dialog), tells the author to delete the key, and names what sizes each dialog now. The `form` item (`FormSchema`, ADR-0159) takes the form view's shape by reference, so it refuses the key at that door too.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts`: the React `ObjectForm` block keeps `modalSize`. It moves from `dataProps` (read off the form view schema) to the block's overlay as a `binding` prop with the same type, and joins `REACT_OVERLAY_SHADOWS.ObjectForm` beside `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth`. The `object-form` page block's own `modalSize` (`ObjectFormPropsSchema`) is untouched.
- D2 conversion `form-view-modal-size-removed` (protocol 19, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.6.0'`): deletes the key from `form`, `formViews.*`, a form view item's `config`, a flattened form overlay, the assembled `viewItems` channel and a `forms[]` item. It never walks page components. Wired into `MAJOR_19_CONVERSIONS` at order 4.
- Retired-key registry: `ui/FormView:modalSize` and `ui/Form:modalSize` under major 19. D3 entry `ui-form-view-modal-size-retired`. The step-19 rationale in `registry.ts.template` gains one sentence.
- Liveness ledger: `view.json` `form.modalSize` and `form.json` `modalSize` go `live` → `dead` with a REMOVED note; state counts regenerated (view 75 live / 11 dead, form 27 live / 6 dead / 2 planned).
- Two protocol-18 conversion fixtures used `modalSize` as the bystander key that must ride through; they now use `tabPosition` and `columns`.
- The protocol-18 D3 entry `ui-form-view-type-layout-only` said the console's New and Edit dialogs were "sized by `modalSize`". They choose their own size; the sentence now says so.
- Regenerated: `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`, `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`, `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`.
- One changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor with the BREAKING banner, FROM → TO and the ADR-0087 marker; `@objectstack/skills` patch for the regenerated reference.

## Tests
- `packages/spec/src/ui/form-view-drawer-keys-retirement.test.ts`:
  - "FormView.modalSize — a tombstone at every form-view door": the five former values are refused at a view's `form`, at `formViews.*`, at a form view item, at a flattened form overlay and at a `form` item, each with one issue at `modalSize` carrying the prescription; a control without the key parses at every door; `defineStack` answers `STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID`; `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[19]` holds both rows; two `@ts-expect-error` lines pin the authoring-site type.
  - "the modal that reads `modalSize` keeps it": the `object-form` page block and the React block overlay still declare it.
  - "the D2 conversion form-view-modal-size-removed": a stored view, a stored form view item and a stored `form` item lose the key; a page block keeps it; a second pass changes nothing; the entry is off the load path and wired at step 19 with its D3 entry.
  - The tree-scoped absence walk now judges `modalSize` on a form view and a `defineForm({…})` body too, with its own matcher anti-vacuity test.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/form-view-type-layout-retirement.test.ts`: the test that pinned "`modalSize` stays declared" now pins the refusal and its message.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`: one join row ties the conversion to the tombstone's removal version.

## Acceptance notes
- File surface beyond the claim, ruled in by the seat on the card (7233916166): the second retired-key row `ui/Form:modalSize` with the conversion's `forms[]` reach, because the `form` item takes the form view's shape by reference; the join row in `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`; and the one-sentence correction to the protocol-18 D3 entry.
- Not edited, by the same ruling: a taxonomy comment in `ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts` still lists `modalSize` among form view keys. Editing it would pull `ui/` and an `@object-ui/types` patch into this narrowing.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`, the `view.form` row, still records `modalSize` as a row that fails today. The QA side updates it after this merges.
- Left as they are, still true: `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` and the D3 entry `internal-record-forms-not-loaded` list `modalSize` among keys that steer nothing on the record dialog.
- `subforms` on a form view is a separate decision and is not touched here.
- hotcrm's uses of the key are not touched here; they meet the refusal when hotcrm moves to spec 19, and `os migrate meta --from 18 --write` deletes them.

## Verification
Read first (by risk):
1. `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`: `FORM_VIEW_MODAL_SIZE_RETIRED` and the `modalSize` member of `FormViewSchema`.
2. `packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/19/form-view-modal-size-removed.ts`: `apply`, in particular the `viewItems` branch that tells a `config` payload from a flattened overlay, and the `forms` walk.
3. `packages/spec/src/ui/react-blocks.ts`: the `ObjectForm` hunk that moves the prop from `dataProps` to the overlay.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/form-view-drawer-keys-retirement.test.ts src/ui/form-view-type-layout-retirement.test.ts src/shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` shows 172 passing; put `z.enum(['sm', 'default', 'lg', 'xl', 'full']).optional()` back on `FormViewSchema.modalSize` and the same command shows 12 failing.
